notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped ordinary attribute-update surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped update and reflect delivery, receive-order metadata, queued message retraction, time-role servicing, object/attribute failures, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped attribute-update and retraction services with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection and retraction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador timestamped attribute declarations
